scope: Resolve the Release 12 versus R13+ subclass-marker boundary for classic POLYLINE/VERTEX inputs, reconcile ACadSharp issues #1278/#1279 with primary Autodesk documentation, and refine existing plan/test ownership.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus targeted local plan/source/test-record inspection

evidence.observed: Autodesk's 1993 R12 DXF reference documents the classic POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND structure and its group-code tables do not define code 100 as a subclass marker.
doesNotEstablish: how all contemporary readers handle extra code-100 strings in a file labeled R12
that extra code-100 records must always be rejected rather than tolerated
evidence.planDisposition: Treat group-100 markers as out-of-profile for R12 input and keep strict R12 output marker-free. Any tolerance is a separate parser compatibility policy.

evidence.observed: Autodesk's current AutoLISP entity-creation guidance says group-100 markers are required for entities introduced in R13+, and explicitly lists pre-R13 POLYLINE, VERTEX, and SEQEND among entities that do not require them.
doesNotEstablish: universal acceptance of every partial marker combination by every CAD parser
a general rule for inferring mesh, polyface, or 3D child roles from the parent
evidence.planDisposition: Do not classify the AC1014 missing-role-marker case as malformed solely because the modern VERTEX table lists a canonical role marker. Retain only the already-bounded 2D compatibility case.

evidence.observed: The modern Autodesk VERTEX page lists AcDbVertex followed by AcDb2dVertex or AcDb3dPolylineVertex. ezdxf's dedicated R12 writer corroborates marker-free legacy serialization but is not treated as normative evidence.
evidence.planDisposition: Preserve version-gated output: marker-free R12; canonical role-specific marker sequence for R13+.

evidence.observed: Issue #1279 describes an AC1014 child VERTEX with AcDbVertex but no more-specific marker and a peer builder exception; no sample hash or independent native result is published. Issue #1278 was available only as a live-index title in this pass and alleges dropped R12 records containing subclass markers.
evidence.planDisposition: Keep #1279 as a narrow legacy-input compatibility scenario and #1278 as a title-level discovery lead; neither establishes a libdxfrw defect or valid-R12 conformance gap.

existingOwnersReinforced: PAR-14/7BS classic compound POLYLINE/VERTEX parsing and boundary isolation
version-specific DXF output profiles and canonical writer markers

validation.reason: Research and plan refinement only; the earlier AC1014 generated-test result was not rerun in this research pass.
